Optimized CV: language en, candidateId, targetRoleTitle. professionalSummary: maybe "Software Engineer III on CI runners team, delivering runner autoscaling and cache service changes with rollout and rollback plans." etc. Must cite sources.

experienceHighlights: list claims with sourceIds.

skills: maybe "Design review, architecture decision records, rollout/rollback planning".

evidenceBoundary: one or two sentences on what materials establish.

HiringEvidencePacket: decisionBoundary: employmentDecisionMade false etc.

candidate: candidateId, sources list all used.

requirementEvidenceMap: for each requirement id.

We need to evaluate each requirement.

req_3a78681dd7f2: Has operated at staff or principal level, setting technical direction across more than one team. Evidence: resume says Software Engineer III on CI runners team for four years, delivering changes. Also note says operating at staff level. But does she set direction across more than one team? Not clear. She contributed to runners section of architecture decision records. Not across more than one team. So insufficient evidence. Missing: evidence of setting direction across multiple teams.

req_7600fc34f966: Has written the architecture decision records that other teams build against and represented a platform in an architecture council. Evidence: She contributed runners section to ADRs written by staff engineer, but did not author. She attended council as guest. So insufficient evidence. Missing: evidence of writing ADRs and representing platform.

req_5bcce0eb6846: Reviews the designs of major platform changes under a documented design review process. Evidence: She reviewed designs as one of two design reviewers, comments recorded. So supported.

req_7f43a00f8ee4: Delivers platform changes with a documented rollout and rollback plan. Evidence: delivered runner autoscaling and cache service changes with rollout and rollback plans. Supported.

req_be03e8cd56d5: Documents the boundaries of each decision record and each design review. Evidence: wrote design review boundary note and decision record boundary section for runners contributions. Supported.

Thus requirementEvidenceMap entries.

supportedClaims: list claims that are supported: reviewing designs, delivering changes with rollout/rollback, documenting boundaries.

unsupportedClaims: maybe claim of operating at staff level? Actually note says she said operating at staff level. That is supported by note. But requirement 3a78681dd7f2 requires setting direction across more than one team. Not supported. So unsupported claim: "operated at staff level and set direction for runners" maybe partially. But we can list unsupported claim: "operated at staff level and set direction for runners" reason: not across more than one team. required follow-up: evidence of direction across multiple teams.

missingEvidenceGaps: for each requirement lacking evidence.

interviewSignalRisks: maybe note about recruiter screen: candidate said she has been 'operating at staff level' and 'set the direction for the runners' and that the group's staff engineer 'mostly rubber-stamped' the records; asked whether she had authored a record or presented at the council, she said not as author. This is a signal risk: unclear authority. Not tied to job evidence. So include.

followUpQuestions: for gaps.

humanReviewChecklist: maybe items like "Verify author of ADRs", "Confirm direction across multiple teams".

auditSummary: paragraph summarizing.

limitations: maybe "Based on provided materials only".
